style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 3 Beaded Large Christmas Bauble
style.toneOfVoice: <p>This Decoris bauble is designed for decorating Christmas trees with a refined and festive look. The pearl color creates a soft glow that stands out beautifully among green branches and warm lights. A decorative bow on top gives the bauble a classic finishing touch while keeping the style clean and elegant. On the Christmas tree, the clustered pearl beads catch the light from every angle, adding subtle sparkle to both traditional and modern themes. </p><ul><li>Bauble made of lightweight foam for easy hanging on tree branches </li><li>Pearl-colored bead surface for a refined and festive appearance </li><li>Diameter of 8 cm, ideal as a noticeable accent among other decorations </li><li>Integrated ribbon with decorative bow serving as both ornament and hanging loop</li><li>Suitable for indoor Christmas tree decoration and coordinated theme styling</li></ul>
